hook_text: A whole month of receipts and payments, and the bank account needs only three lines. Here is the trick.
clip_script: First of April: the bank folder already holds seventy-four thousand one hundred and eighty rand from March. Now file April. Every receipt in the cash receipts journal adds up to thirty-one thousand three hundred and thirty: one line on the left of bank, total receipts. Every payment in the cash payments journal: twenty-five thousand three hundred and twenty-five, one line on the right, total payments. The other halves go to their own folders: current income, capital, wages, equipment, one by one. Now balance. Left side: one hundred and five thousand five hundred and ten. Right side: twenty-five thousand three hundred and twenty-five. Left in the bank: eighty thousand one hundred and eighty-five. Carry it down, bring it down, and May begins.
visual_style: A whiteboard filing cabinet with labelled T-shaped folders, two journals feeding totals into the bank folder, and a balance line drawn with a double rule beneath matching totals.
mood: Satisfying and orderly, a neat system clicking into place.
pacing: A quick opening balance, two fast postings, then a slower balancing reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and post April's journals yourself.
